task.title: Prompt and context engineering standard — adopt the .ai governance layer
task.business_value: Stops every seat from re-deriving state, losing artifacts between tools, and asking the founder to execute tool work. Directly reduces usage-credit waste (D17) and blocked assignments (two staging packages were never retrievable).
task.objective: Every assignment and handoff carries addressable artifact coordinates, a repository SHA, graded evidence and explicit permissions, and is validated fail-closed before any seat acts on it.

steps.action: Audit the eight continuity documents and record contradictions
Create .ai registries, schemas, docs/ai standards, scripts/ai validators and fail-closed tests
Run vitest, tsc, eslint, build and the ai:check gate
Commit, push to a new branch and open a PR against main
Issue the next INBOX assignment as ASSIGNMENT_SCHEMA.json-conformant JSON (or Markdown with an embedded JSON block)
Lovable returns results as HANDOFF_SCHEMA.json-conformant handoffs with git coordinates

task.rollback: Revert the governance commit(s) on this branch; no runtime, schema or deployment change is involved.
